bash: cd /app && node -e '
const fs=require("fs");
const site = ["src/index.html","src/publications.html","src/blog.html","src/blog/building-interpretable-models.html","src/blog/bridging-ml-single-cell-genomics.html","src/blog/scaling-gnns-connectomics.html"]
  .map(f=>fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8")).join(" ").replace(/&[a-z]+;|&\#\d+;/g," ");
const norm = s => s.toLowerCase().replace(/[\u2010-\u2015\u2018\u2019\u201c\u201d]/g,"\x27").replace(/[^a-z0-9 ]/g," ").replace(/\s+/g," ");
const hay = norm(site);
const checks = [
 "Dr. Lydia Moreno is an associate professor of Computational Neuroscience",
 "Riverbend University",
 "Baywood Institute of Technology",
 "Northborough Research Center",
 "Neural Encoding",
 "Biomedical Imaging",
 "Single-Cell Omics",
 "Explainable AI",
 "DeepVision",
 "NeuroGraph",
 "CellMap",
 "Cascade Imaging Lab",
 "12 labs worldwide",
 "ICSCG",
 "Temporal Convolutional Networks",
 "Graph Embedding Techniques",
 "Integrative Single-Cell Atlas",
 "Explainable AI Techniques in Neural Decoding",
 "Building Interpretable Deep Learning Models",
 "Bridging Machine Learning and Single-Cell Genomics",
 "Scaling Graph Neural Networks for Connectomics",
 "Introduction to Computational Neuroscience",
 "Advanced Machine Learning Methods in Biology",
 "8 Ph.D. students and 12",
 "Nextflow","Snakemake","Kubernetes","NetworkX","Scanpy","Plotly",
 "lydia.moreno@riverbend.edu","Blakely Hall, Room 312","LydiaNeuroLab","lydia-moreno",
 "magna cum laude","Crestfield College of Engineering","Statistical Methods for Single-Cell"
];
let miss=checks.filter(c=>!hay.includes(norm(c)));
console.log(miss.length? "MISSING FROM SITE:\n - "+miss.join("\n - ") : `OK: all ${checks.length} CV facts present in the site`);
'
